subject.title: fix: require admin for keyed session model changes [AI]

question: Should changing an adopted keyed session’s resolved model or thinking level be treated as an `operator.admin` operation even for existing write-scoped Gateway clients?
rationale: This is an intentional authorization and upgrade-contract change, not a mechanical test decision; it can stop previously permitted write-scoped client workflows.

options.title: Approve the admin boundary
options.body: Accept the compatibility change and merge after real Gateway proof demonstrates the write-denied and admin-allowed paths.

options.title: Preserve write-scoped mutation
options.body: Keep current write-scoped behavior and pursue a narrower security design only if a distinct unsafe capability is identified.

options.title: Define a transitional contract
options.body: Specify an explicit compatibility or migration path for existing write-scoped keyed-session clients before changing enforcement.

recommendation.title: Approve the admin boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the compatibility change and merge after real Gateway proof demonstrates the write-denied and admin-allowed paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the authorization contract and can determine whether this persisted-session mutation belongs behind admin scope.
